literal.prompt: Как называют морской лёд, закреплённый у берега и не дрейфующий свободно?

literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO distinguishes fast ice attached to shore or ocean floor from drift ice unattached to either (L30). NSIDC identifies the adjacent alternatives as frazil crystals, nilas, and pancake ice, so “припай” uniquely fits the attachment predicate.
literalGroups.locator: WMO Sea Ice L29-L30; NSIDC L83-L88

literalGroups.literal: Это припай — морской лёд, прикреплённый к берегу или дну океана. Место прикрепления удерживает его от свободного дрейфа.
literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO L30 directly defines fast ice by attachment to shore or ocean floor; the explanation states the same defining relation and resulting lack of free drift.

literalGroups.literal: Игловидные кристаллы фразиля появляются при начале замерзания морской воды, всплывают и срастаются в ледяной лист.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC describes frazil as small needle-like ice crystals formed as ocean water begins freezing and later floating/aggregating (L84).

literalGroups.literal: Припай может прикрепляться не только к берегу, но и ко дну океана.
literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO defines fast ice as attached to shore or ocean floor; the note adds the latter attachment site beyond shore.

literalGroups.literal: Нилас — тонкая упругая сплошная корка морского льда.
literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO identifies nilas as a thin elastic crust under 10 cm; NSIDC describes its development as a continuous thin sheet (L85).
literalGroups.locator: WMO Sea Ice L30; NSIDC L85

literalGroups.literal: Блинчатый лёд образует округлые диски с приподнятыми краями, которые сталкиваются на волнах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC describes pancake ice as slushy circular disks with raised edges caused by wave collisions (L88); this is distinct from attachment-defined fast ice.
literalGroups.locator: NSIDC L88; WMO Sea Ice L30

correctNoteNewFact.newFact: Fast ice can attach to the ocean floor as well as to the shore named in the prompt.
correctNoteNewFact.whyNew: The prompt and key identify shore attachment/no free drift but do not mention attachment to the ocean floor; this adds a concrete property of the correct category.

entries.absoluteDifficulty: HARD is unchanged and remains supported for a general adult audience: selecting “припай” requires specialized sea-ice classification by attachment and distinguishes it from adjacent formation/morphology categories; the frozen prompt is specific rather than broad everyday knowledge. This is an editorial judgment, not audience statistics.
